title: Dated institutional claim and source ledger
interpretation: SRS 4400 contains agreed-procedures factual findings and expresses no assurance conclusion. SAE 3000 gives limited assurance only on its specified assertions and floors. These institutional measures do not establish a clinical outcome, treatment efficacy or independent endorsement.

claims.countingRule: Includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training; it is not a count of successful therapy sessions.
claims.title: Cumulative services
claims.definition: Therapy service includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training. It does not mean 31 million independently verified successful therapy sessions.
claims.summary: 31 million+ documented therapy services: floor subject to independent limited assurance; 31,052,382 recorded in the related factual-findings report at 17 July 2026.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on >=31,000,000 floor; 31,052,382 factual finding

srs4400.kind: Agreed-procedures factual finding; no assurance conclusion

sae3000.kind: Limited assurance on the specified assertion or floor, not on every reported value
